name: FilterBar
description: Composition of keyword search and child DataFilter controls, with structured aggregate events and clear-all action.
events: cu-filter-change {query,conditions,activeCount} from search input, filter changes or clear

accessibility.keyboard: Native search input, clear button; child Selects accessible via keyboard
accessibility.output: Application can use applyFilterBar helper for client-side arrays
accessibility.styling: Fluent Calm semantic tokens with focus and high contrast

notes: applyFilterBar(rows,query,conditions,searchKeys) composes DataTable structured filters with text query
